name: Mountain Pipit
rangeDescription: South africa (drakensberg mountains of southern lesotho)
description: A large, dark, boldly marked pipit with a pinkish base to the bill. Pairs breed in alpine scrub and grassland above 2000 meters of elevation from October to April, before dispersing to wintering grounds presumed to be in Central Africa.

name: Blue-banded Toucanet
rangeDescription: Andes of eastern peru (huánuco) to southern bolivia (santa cruz, chuquisaca)
description: Small green toucan of humid montane forest. Blue chest band is distinctive but can be difficult to see; notice also the bluish coloration in its face and bill and the yellowish bill tip.

name: Grande Comore Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Grand comoro island (mount karthala)
description: A distinctive and attractive flycatcher that is endemic to Grand Comoro. Dark brown on the upperparts and heavily streaked below, with a yellow bill and feet and white wingbars.

name: Savanna Hawk
rangeDescription: Savanna and marshes of western panama to brazil and northern argentina
description: Beautiful orangish raptor with a widespread distribution across Central and South America. Overall cinnamon-colored with dark barring on the underparts.

name: Varzea Piculet
rangeDescription: Amazonian brazil (lower rio madeira to far western pará)
description: Tiny, dark brown woodpecker. Plumage varies; typically darker and more unmarked in the east and more barred toward the west, but usually looks scaled with white spots.

name: Bare-cheeked Trogon
rangeDescription: Lowland rainforest of cameroon, gabon, and northeastern democratic republic of the congo
description: A trogon of lowland rainforests, almost always found in the forest interior, away from forest edges. Males and females have distinctive bare yellow facial skin below their eyes and between their eyes and bill.

name: Black-crowned Fulvetta
rangeDescription: Southern vietnam (langbian plateau)
description: Adorable small fulvetta with large, liquid cartoon eyes. Plain brown overall.

name: Blue-headed Pitta
rangeDescription: Primary lowland forest of borneo
description: Small and unique gem-like pitta of Borneo’s lowland dipterocarp forests—both pristine and logged. Male’s glowing electric-blue crown is eye-catching even in the gloom of the forest floor; also note dark blue underparts, bright white throat, and cinnamon-brown back.

name: Green Oropendola
rangeDescription: The guianas and southern venezuela to northeastern peru, northwestern bolivia (eastern pando), and amazonian brazil
description: Large, stocky bird. Green-and-chestnut plumage can look mostly black under some conditions and at a distance.

name: Masked Bunting
rangeDescription: Sakhalin and southern kuril islands to honshu; winters to ryukyu islands (southern japan)
description: A small migratory songbird breeding in low to mid-elevation, moist mixed forest and wintering in woodland and scrub, preferring thick undergrowth, especially dwarf bamboo. Brown, streaked upperparts, grayish head and pale yellow underparts with fine, dark streaking.

name: Anchieta's Sunbird
rangeDescription: Angola to southeastern democratic republic of the congo, zambia, southwestern tanzania, malawi, and northern mozambique
description: Small, distinctive sunbird, red and yellow below with iridescent blue on the forehead, throat, and breast. The male and female are similar, though the female is duller.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Dusky Nightjar
rangeDescription: Montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: Small dark nightjar with very limited range in the highlands of Costa Rica and Panama. Few obvious plumage features: entire body is intricately patterned with dark brown, black, and buff.

name: White-lined Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Northern australia (sandstones of western arnhem land, northern territory)
description: Rather plain medium-sized honeyeater found in sandstone escarpment and gorge country of western Arnhem Land, including the sandstone areas of Kakadu National Park and Katherine Gorge. Upperparts uniformly gray-green, underparts pale with diffuse gray streaks on chest.

name: Lazuline Sabrewing
rangeDescription: Mountains of colombia, venezuela, and eastern ecuador
description: Large, distinctive hummingbird. Males have bright blue underparts with maroon tail and downcurved bill.

name: Rufous-crested Tanager
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia to southwestern venezuela and eastern peru (ayacucho)
description: This uncommon tanager is found in the subtropical zone of the Andes from Colombia to Peru. Medium gray above and rich buffy below with a stout hooked bill.

name: Chestnut-breasted Partridge
rangeDescription: Coniferous foothill forest of sikkim to southeastern tibet
description: Ornate partridge of east Himalayan foothill forests. Often in areas with dense bamboo stands.

name: Rufous-bellied Antwren
rangeDescription: Southern venezuela to the guianas and northeastern amazonian brazil
description: Tiny resident of tall rainforest. Wary and can be difficult to see well; note distinctive sputtering alarm call, tiny size, plain face, and large white (male) or buffy (female) wing spots.

name: Green Thorntail
rangeDescription: Costa rica to panama, western colombia, and western ecuador
description: Tiny hummingbird with short straight bill. Male all shimmering green with distinctive, long, pointed tail feathers.

name: Hume's Wheatear
rangeDescription: Bare rocky hills of eastern arabia to southern iran, afghanistan, and pakistan
description: Large wheatear with dark black head and back, and pure white breast and belly. Sexes alike.

name: Barred Dove
rangeDescription: Southeastern moluccas and lesser sundas
description: A small, long-tailed dove with extensive barring over its body. Pale gray head with distinctive orange eye-ring.
